Best Coding AI Tools

13 coding AI tools, compared by features, pricing and rating. Open any tool for details and similar alternatives.

AI tools in this category

  • GitHub Copilot: AI pair programmer that suggests code completions and entire functions in real-time inside your editor.
  • Cursor: AI-first code editor built on VS Code. Chat with your codebase, edit with AI, generate entire features.
  • Tabnine: AI coding assistant with private code model training. Enterprise-ready with full privacy controls.
  • Replit AI: AI-powered cloud IDE that lets you build, run, and deploy apps entirely in the browser with AI help.
  • Codeium: Free AI code completion tool supporting 70+ programming languages with fast, accurate suggestions.
  • Amazon CodeWhisperer: AWS AI coding companion with security scanning and AWS-specific code suggestions.
  • Bolt.new: Prompt, run and deploy full-stack apps right in the browser with an AI that sets up the project for you.
  • Claude Code: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that works in your terminal, IDE and the web to read, edit and run code.
  • Lovable: Describe an app in plain English and get a working full-stack web app you can iterate on and deploy.
  • Sourcegraph Cody: Coding assistant that uses your whole codebase as context for answers, edits and refactors.
  • v0 by Vercel: Generate React and Tailwind UI components and full pages from prompts or screenshots.
  • Warp: Modern terminal with AI that turns plain English into commands and explains errors.
  • Windsurf: AI-native IDE with an agent that understands your whole project and edits across files.
